summary: HUTCHMED filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) disclosing that partner AstraZeneca submitted a US NDA to the FDA for ORPATHYS (savolitinib) plus TAGRISSO (osimertinib) in MET-driven EGFR-mutated NSCLC after EGFR-TKI progression. No stake, price, premium or deal terms were stated; no board recommendation or advisor named. The application rests on the global SAFFRON Phase III trial showing significant PFS and OS gains versus platinum doublet chemotherapy, with data to be presented at ESMO 2026. This is a routine regulatory/product pipeline update, not a special situation.
